description: Use this when someone asks what their competitors are doing, why buyers pick a competitor, or for a battlecard: returns the workspace's Competitors page: its competitors' recent moves (launches, pricing, partnerships, funding, home page changes), each from its own page with its date and link; how many of the people it interviewed picked or named each competitor; how often AI answers cite each one's site; and battlecards of why buyers pick each one and where it falls short, in people's own words. Name a competitor to see only it. The page is built the first time it is asked for, usually within 15 minutes; meanwhile this returns the competitor moves GatherHQ found. It runs no research, and it is not for news about other companies: search the web for that.

competitor.description: A competitor's name, e.g. "Carrum Health", to see only it.

name: gather_competitors
title: Your competitors
